capabilities: Translate plugin interface labels into Simplified Chinese
Translate current theme Style Settings labels
Resume interrupted translation jobs from checkpoints
disambiguation: Not a note or content translator; it only rewrites recognizable plugin and theme setting labels in the display layer.
extras: Free and open source (MIT); third-party services may charge. Desktop dictionaries are stored outside the vault under ObsidianBilingualAssistant; mobile dictionaries live in the vault plugins directory. Android/iPhone, macOS/Linux and real-provider translation quality are untested; testing used a local simulated service. Replaces the older bilingual-assistant plugin ID; both must not be enabled at once. Dynamic strings, native menus, images, iframes and some controls may stay untranslated.
problem: Obsidian plugin interfaces and theme Style Settings are in English, and Obsidian has no built-in way to show them in Simplified Chinese.

requires.name: DeepSeek, OpenAI, OpenRouter, OpenAI-compatible endpoint, DeepL or self-hosted DeepLX
Translation service API key stored in Obsidian SecretStorage

summary: Plugin that translates English plugin interface labels and the current theme's Style Settings into Simplified Chinese using online services, then applies saved dictionaries offline.
